review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares no simp lemmas and no simp attributes. Its only local simp-style tool is the private helper `preimage_spec_comp`. That lemma is oriented to move `Spec.map v` out of the pulled-back global section, and it is used only inside explicit `simpa only [...]` calls. I saw no unwanted expansion or competing rules, and I found no rewrite cycle by inspection. I did not run Lean, so I did not test for simplifier loops. It is also not obviously worth making `preimage_spec_comp` a global simp lemma: it mentions `appTop` and `ΓSpecIso` together with an arbitrary target scheme, and its use is narrow. Mathlib's `Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality` is already `@[reassoc (attr := simp)]`. The inverse-direction form `ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality` is used in the rewrite proof of `preimage_spec_comp`. I did not find a canonical simp lemma that is missing. The repeated closed-immersion-to-`Mono` boilerplate is a proof-duplication matter, not a simp-interface one. The projection and zero-section lemmas the file relies on are in the neighbouring file `UnitriangularStageCoordinates.lean`. One of them, `unitriangularStageCoordinateMap_π`, is already `@[simp]`. I found no simp-interface defect in this file.
